title: Thai Sea Bass Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-inspired stir fry made with sea bass, gooey sauce, and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Add the sea bass fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side or until cooked through.
4. Remove the sea bass from the skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and stir-fry the Thai basil until wilted.
6. Add the gooey sauce to the skillet and stir-fry for 1 minute until combined with the basil.
7. Return the sea bass to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
8. Serve the sea bass hot, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired.
9. Optional: Top with a dollop of Greek yogurt and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
